name: Past Paper
statement: Pour water into a cylinder with a radius of 7cm until the depth of water is 8cm high. Then a rectangular iron bar with length 6cm, width 9cm and height 15.4cm is put into the cylinder so that it is vertically standing inside the cylinder. Suppose no water is leaked, what is the rise in water level in cm? (Take $\pi = \dfrac{22}{7}$)
